insight: Founded by Angela Hoover (YC W22); raised $2.5M and named PCMag's Best Free AI Search Engine three years running.
name: Andi
tagline: Ad-free, privacy-first AI search that answers instead of returning links.
description: Andi is a generative AI search engine that gives direct, summarized answers in a conversational interface rather than a page of links. It runs its own search index and a proprietary content-understanding backend, layering language models on top to assess source meaning and quality. It positions itself as private and ad-free, with the core search staying free.

modelSupport.notes: Combines LLMs with its own search index and semantic backend; models not user-selectable.

edge: Privacy-first and ad-free with its own search index — direct answers and summaries instead of tracked link lists.
cons: Answers can lack depth vs larger rivals
Smaller team and index than incumbents

references.title: Y Combinator-backed Andi taps AI to build a better search engine
